channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: RJ: Ao usar renúncia para burlar TSE, Castro comprometeu eleição indireta
item.description: Former Rio de Janeiro governor Claudio Castro resigned to avoid disqualification and ineligibility by the TSE, but the STF views this as an attempt to circumvent electoral law. This maneuver risks invalidating the indirect election meant to choose the state’s new governor, undermining the legitimacy of the process.

item.title: Bispo que dá apoio espiritual a Bolsonaro articula por Messias no STF: ‘Não sendo ele, será um pior’
item.description: Bishop Robson Rodovalho, a friend of Jair Bolsonaro and authorized by the STF to provide spiritual assistance to the former president, is rallying support for Lula’s nominee to the STF, Jorge Messias, who is also evangelical. He describes Messias as a 'genuine Christian' committed to faith, noting that despite being a petista, he does not support progressive agendas like drug decriminalization or abortion, making him the best left-wing option for evangelicals. Rodovalho criticizes Lula for not making intensive efforts to win over the evangelical vote and warned that if Messias is not chosen, Lula will nominate someone 'much worse'.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro consegue liminar para excluir postagens de quem o associa ao crime organizado
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for the Presidency of Brazil, obtained a preliminary injunction requiring Facebook to remove, within 48 hours, Instagram posts associating him with criminal organizations and the death of police officers. The ruling aims to curb the spread of content deemed defamatory by the legislator. Full access to the article is available only to subscribers.

item.title: Dança das cadeiras
item.description: The party window led to a congressional reorganization, with growth in the PL and PSD, maintaining right-wing dominance. Around 120 parliamentarians switched parties, consolidating Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL) presidential candidacy, while the PSD, led by Ronaldo Caiado, positions itself as a right-wing alternative, proposing amnesty for those involved in the January 8 attacks. The left retained the PT as its main party but lost PDT members, with the PSB growing — yet the rightward shift remains entrenched.

item.title: Reestruturação de carreiras do governo é avanço incremental, dizem analistas
item.description: Career restructuring in the Lula government is viewed by analysts as an incremental modernization, not a deep administrative transformation. Public management experts say the changes aim for efficiency and regulatory updates without overhauling existing structures.

item.title: Associações de juízes articulam obstáculo ao fim da aposentadoria compulsória como punição
item.description: Judges' associations are seeking to create a loophole in the PEC that abolishes compulsory retirement as punishment, proposing that removal from office depend on a final judicial decision. Rapporteur Eliziane Gama (PSB-MA) maintains the text aligned with Minister Flávio Dino's ruling, which requires the punishment to be ratified by the STF. Senators resist changes due to the election year and fear of public backlash.

item.title: Pacote anunciado pelo governo vai impedir a disparada dos preços dos combustíveis? Especialistas opinam
item.description: The Lula government announced a new package of measures to curb rising fuel prices, including subsidies for diesel, cooking gas (LPG), and aviation kerosene (QAV), credit for airlines, and strengthened oversight. The actions aim to mitigate the impact of surging oil prices due to the Middle East conflict, in an election year marked by inflation concerns.

item.title: Em 4 anos, força digital de Tarcísio superou a de Haddad, que precisará recuperar terreno nas eleições de 2026
item.description: Over the past four years, Tarcísio de Freitas surpassed Fernando Haddad in digital presence, growing from 2.9 million to 11.3 million followers, while Haddad remained at 7.6 million. This shift stems from Tarcísio’s aggressive content strategy, including videomakers and drone footage, contrasting with Haddad’s low-profile role as Finance Minister. Nonetheless, Haddad’s campaign asserts it will regain ground in the 2026 elections by prioritizing digital channels.

item.title: Space Liberdade: perfil no X que foi pivô de embate entre Eduardo e Nikolas é alvo frequente do ex-deputado
item.description: The 'Space Liberdade' profile on X, with around 450,000 followers and created in October 2023, became a focal point of a dispute between Eduardo Bolsonaro and Nikolas Ferreira after the Minas Gerais deputy shared a video from the page. Eduardo accused Keven Oliveira, identified as one of the profile's administrators, of 'preaching null votes,' while the account shares right-leaning news, religious messages, voting intention polls, and criticisms of Supreme Court ministers, alongside support for Bolsonarist agendas.

item.title: Com fim da janela partidária, PL amplia bancada na Alerj e fortalece apoio a Ruas
item.description: Following the party window, the PL expanded its bench in Alerj to 22 deputies, strengthening support for Douglas Ruas in the race for the Assembly presidency and interim Rio governorship. The party now totals 33 deputies with União Brasil and PP, just three shy of the majority needed in an indirect election. The PSD, led by Eduardo Paes, rose from six to ten deputies and is building an alliance with PT, PCdoB, PSB, PDT and MDB to reach at least 20 votes, awaiting judicial rulings that could level the playing field.

item.title: Desenho de candidaturas à Presidência indica primeira disputa sem mulheres desde 2002
item.description: The current outline of presidential candidacies for 2026 includes no women, which, if confirmed, would mark the first time since 2002 that the race for the Planalto features only men. President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) are the leading figures so far. Experts say the absence of female candidates reflects structural party barriers that hinder women’s representation in executive offices.

item.title: Aneel vota nesta terça processo que pode cassar contrato da Enel em SP
item.description: Aneel is set to vote on Tuesday (April 7) on a process that could lead to the cancellation of Enel’s contract in São Paulo, following blackouts in 2023 and 2024 and service failures. The administrative procedure, previously suspended by a court injunction, has been reinstated after a judicial decision and may result in the concession’s forfeiture, valid until 2028, with the final decision resting with the federal government.

item.title: Como Nikolas foi de bolsonarista raiz a protagonista de racha na direita
item.description: Nikolas Ferreira, once a key strategist of Bolsonarism and Brazil's most-voted federal deputy in 2022, has become the target of public criticism from Eduardo Bolsonaro over alleged endorsements of Bolsonarism’s enemies, exposing an internal rift in the right-wing movement. The conflict reveals a struggle for leadership and influence within Bolsonarism, with Nikolas allegedly orchestrating a boycott of Flávio Bolsonaro’s 2026 presidential bid.

item.title: Para garantir prorrogação, CPI do Crime pode se distanciar do Master, diz relator
item.description: The Organized Crime CPI seeks to extend its work by 60 days but plans to distance itself from investigations into Banco Master to avoid resistance from Senate President Davi Alcolumbre during an election year. Rapporteur Alessandro Vieira states that frauds linked to Daniel Vorcaro fall within the committee’s scope, but the focus will now shift to militias and criminal factions, while also advocating for a separate CPI to investigate Master.

item.title: Acordo entre Goiás e EUA sobre minerais vira alvo de ação na PGR
item.description: Deputy Dandara Tonantzin (PT-MG) has asked the PGR to investigate the constitutionality of a memorandum of understanding between the state of Goiás and the United States regarding critical minerals and rare earths, arguing that the agreement oversteps state authority and invades federal jurisdiction, as mineral resources belong to the Union. Governor Ronaldo Caiado signed the agreement on March 18 with U.S. Charge d'Affaires Gabriel Escobar in São Paulo, aiming to prioritize rare earth exploration in Goiás and secure funding for studies. The deputy alleges possible administrative impropriety, usurpation of public office, and other illegalities in the act.

item.title: Diretas são única saída legal para a sucessão no Rio
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) will rule tomorrow on the injunction that suspended the indirect election for Rio de Janeiro's interim governor following Claudio Castro's (PL) resignation. The article argues that Castro's resignation was a maneuver to avoid impeachment and retain political control, insisting that succession must occur through a direct election as mandated by law. Amid Rio's political crisis, the Court must uphold constitutional order and prevent electoral fraud disguised as institutional transition.

item.title: O voto é a voz do Rio
item.description: Former Governor Claudio Castro resigned on the eve of his TSE cassation over serious electoral crimes, seeking to evade Article 224 of the Electoral Code and replace the popular vote with a legislative appointment by Alerj, in an alleged constitutional fraud. The article condemns this maneuver as an affront to democracy and the rule of law.

item.title: Líderes da Câmara tentam acordo para votar indicação ao TCU nesta semana
item.description: Chamber leaders set the date for the TCU minister election, expected this Wednesday, following internal agreements. The vote is seen as a test of strength for Chamber President Hugo Motta, who aims to secure Odair Cunha’s (PT-MG) victory to fulfill a 2024 deal with the PT, despite internal resistance. The secret ballot includes candidates such as Hugo Leal, Elmar Nascimento, Hélio Lopes, Danilo Forte, Adriana Ventura, and Gilson Daniel, filling the vacancy left by Aroldo Cedraz.

item.title: Caiado, Tebet, Moro, Pacheco: veja políticos que trocaram de partido para disputar a eleição
item.description: Following the closure of the party switching window in April, several prominent politicians changed parties ahead of the 2026 elections. Ronaldo Caiado left União Brasil for the PSD to run for president; Sergio Moro moved to the PL to pursue the governorship of Paraná; Simone Tebet exited the MDB after 30 years to join the PSB and run for Senate in São Paulo; and Rodrigo Pacheco shifted from PSD to PSB in Minas Gerais, with federal government backing, eyeing a gubernatorial bid.

item.title: Cálculo do governo ao mandar indicação de Messias considera crise e formação completa no STF
item.description: The Lula government has submitted Jorge Messias's nomination to the STF to the Senate, aiming to complete the Court amid reputational crisis and key upcoming rulings. The move was expedited due to the election year, with concerns that Congress would delay proceedings and that Senate President Davi Alcolumbre might postpone the hearing until after October. STF ministers including Zanin, Nunes Marques, Gilmar Mendes, and André Mendonça are reportedly supporting Messias, setting the stage for an internal factional struggle over his future alignment on the bench.

item.title: CPI do Crime entra na reta final sob incerteza de prorrogação; relator deve encontrar Alcolumbre
item.description: The Organized Crime CPI is entering its final phase with a deadline to conclude on February 14, amid uncertainty over its extension due to the electoral context and resistance from Senate President Davi Alcolumbre. Rapporteur Alessandro Vieira (MDB-SE) is seeking a negotiated solution with Alcolumbre, ruling out, for now, the judicialization of the extension, despite having previously appealed to the Supreme Court in other CPI requests, such as the 'CPI da Toga'.

item.title: Janja diz que Lula comeu paca legal, mas Planalto não informa origem
item.description: First Lady Janja Lula da Silva prepared paca meat for Easter lunch with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, stating it was a gift from a licensed producer. Her Instagram video shows the seasoning process with garlic, green onions, and herbs, and Lula praising the dish as 'divine'. The Planalto did not respond to Poder360’s requests for documentation proving the legal origin of the meat.

item.title: Mendonça diz esperar Jorge Messias no STF “em breve”
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça said he expects Jorge Messias, the current head of the AGU, to soon join the STF following the retirement of Luís Roberto Barroso. The comment was made during an award ceremony at the São Paulo Legislative Assembly, where Messias was present as Lula’s nominee. Mendonça also noted his role as rapporteur in major investigations and was rated the most favorably viewed justice in a recent AtlasIntel poll.

item.title: Mendonça diz que magistrados precisam de ‘grau de contenção a mais’ para manter credibilidade
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça urged judges and public officials to exercise an additional degree of restraint to preserve judicial credibility, noting that not all legally permissible actions are advisable for institutional integrity. Speaking during a tribute at the São Paulo State Legislature, he reaffirmed his commitment to impartiality and integrity without directly referencing the cases he oversees — involving the Banco Master and INSS — which implicate figures tied to the Lula government, Centrão, and opposition.

item.title: André Mendonça recebe louvores e homenagem de Tarcísio em SP
item.description: Minister André Mendonça received the Legislative Merit Honor Collar at the São Paulo State Assembly in recognition of his work at the Supreme Federal Court, with Governor Tarcísio de Freitas present and the ceremony featuring prayers and worship music. The tribute was proposed by Deputy Oseias de Madureira and included participation from evangelical leaders. Mendonça, appointed by Bolsonaro and rapporteur of the Master and INSS cases, was praised by Tarcísio as being spiritually gifted by God.

item.title: ‘Não é inteligente’: a resposta de Flávio Bolsonaro sobre a postura de Eduardo contra Nikolas
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president in 2026, publicly criticized his brother Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL-SP) for his confrontational stance toward Deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG), stating Eduardo's behavior is 'not intelligent' and creates unnecessary conflict. Flávio praised Nikolas as a 'mature guy' who 'understands the political game,' urging unity within the Bolsonarist base for Brazil's purported survival.

item.title: Ao lado de Tarcísio e Messias, André Mendonça recebe homenagem na Alesp
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça received the Honra ao Mérito medal, the highest honor of the São Paulo State Legislature, in a ceremony attended by Governor Tarcísio de Freitas and Mayor Ricardo Nunes. Former Attorney General Jorge Messias, nominated by President Lula for the STF, was also present and has been publicly supported by Mendonça for the vacant seat. Mendonça stressed his commitment to impartiality in rulings despite his evangelical background and highlighted his recent role as rapporteur in the Banco Master case and INSS fraud investigations.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que postura crítica de Eduardo a Nikolas 'não é inteligente'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, senator and pre-candidate for Presidency, criticized his brother Eduardo Bolsonaro's public stance against deputy Nikolas Ferreira, calling it counterproductive and not intelligent. He urged unity within the PL party, stating that public divisions harm the Bolsonaro family's political project in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Com Tarcísio e Messias, Alesp homenageia Mendonça em ato de tom religioso
item.description: Minister André Mendonça of the STF was honored by the São Paulo Legislative Assembly (Alesp) with the Legislative Merit Honor Medal in a ceremony marked by religious tone, including prayers, biblical references, and performances by evangelical groups. Attendees included Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, Mayor Ricardo Nunes, STF nominee Jorge Messias, and various officials, alongside deputies from different parties such as Oseias de Madureira (PL) and Emídio de Souza (PT).

item.title: Flávio volta a falar sobre “rachadinha” e nega envolvimento
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) revisited the 'rachadinha' scandal in an interview with podcast Inteligência Ltda, stating he intends to address the issue during the 2026 presidential pre-campaign. He acknowledged that his former aide Fabrício Queiroz admitted to collecting part of staff salaries, but denied having knowledge of the practice, labeling the accusations as an attempt to destroy him.

item.title: Soraya troca Podemos pelo PSB para firmar aliança com PT em MS
item.description: Senator Soraya Thronicke (MS) officially left Podemos to join the PSB, aiming to strengthen her re-election campaign and form an alliance with the PT in Mato Grosso do Sul. The move, negotiated since February, followed meetings with PT leaders Vander Loubet and Fábio Trad, and received approval from national PSB president João Campos and Vice President Geraldo Alckmin. Having broken with Bolsonaro and declared support for Lula, Soraya seeks a stronger electoral structure to contest one of the two Senate seats in the state in 2026.

item.title: Temer diz que polarização é o principal desafio para Caiado em 2026
item.description: Former President Michel Temer said Ronaldo Caiado, the PSD’s presidential pre-candidate for 2026, is a competitive name but must overcome the polarization between Lula and Bolsonaro to be effective. He praised Caiado’s 'extraordinary mileage' in public life and urged the electoral debate to focus on economic proposals, not personal attacks. Caiado stepped down as governor of Goiás on March 31 to run for president, with Vice Governor Daniel Vilela (MDB) assuming the role.

item.title: Medidas de Lula para diesel, gás e querosene custam R$ 31 bi
item.description: Lula's measures for diesel, gas, and kerosene will cost up to R$ 31 billion in 2026, according to the economic team, but the government claims fiscal neutrality due to increased oil royalty revenue, projected at up to R$ 40 billion with Brent crude at US$ 90. The measures include subsidies for domestic and imported diesel producers, PIS/Cofins tax cuts, and support for LPG, aviation kerosene, and biodiesel, with states sharing part of the burden.

item.title: Alesp concede a André Mendonça o Colar de Honra ao Mérito
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça received the Legislative Merit Collar from the São Paulo State Assembly (Alesp) in a solemn session attended by Governor Tarcísio de Freitas and Mayor Ricardo Nunes. The honor, proposed by Deputy Oseias de Madureira (PL), recognizes his contributions to the state's social, cultural, and economic development. Mendonça, who leads key investigations at the STF including the Banco Master case and INSS fraud probes, was honored amid the 2026 electoral political landscape.

item.title: “Trans de direita”: Sophia Barclay se filia ao PL por vaga na Câmara
item.description: Influencer Sophia Barclay formally joined the Liberal Party (PL) and announced her pre-candidacy for federal deputy from São Paulo in the 2026 elections, identifying as a 'trans of the right anti-woke'. The affiliation was confirmed alongside the party's national president, Valdemar Costa Neto. Barclay previously had a public dispute with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in 2023 after accusing him of having a relationship with a trans woman, leading to a police complaint for defamation and mutual accusations.

item.title: Geddel chama Caiado de “genérico”: “Não representa nada na Bahia”
item.description: Geddel Vieira Lima criticized Ronaldo Caiado, stating he 'represents absolutely nothing in Bahia' and is a 'Bolsonaro clone', dismissing his viability as a conservative alternative for 2026. He argued voters prefer the 'original' (Bolsonaro) over the 'generic' (Caiado) and expressed confidence in the PT-led ticket of Jerônimo Rodrigues and Geraldo Júnior in Bahia.

item.title: Flávio questiona “condições psiquiátricas” de Renan Santos
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) questioned the psychiatric conditions of Renan Santos, president of the Mission party and pre-candidate for President, stating he 'does not have the psychiatric conditions to govern anything'. Both are pre-candidates for the 2026 Brazilian presidency.

item.title: Ministro André Mendonça recebe Colar de Honra ao Mérito em sessão solene na Alesp com presença de Tarcísio e Nunes
item.description: Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça received the Collar of Honor from the São Paulo Legislative Assembly in a solemn session attended by Governor Tarcísio de Freitas and Mayor Ricardo Nunes. The honor recognizes his career as Attorney General, Justice Minister, and STF member since 2021. The ceremony featured religious presentations and included authorities from the three branches of government.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro recebe oração em igreja evangélica em São Paulo
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), a pre-candidate for president, received a prayer at an evangelical church in São Paulo, marking the start of a series of visits to religious leaders to court the evangelical vote in the 2026 elections. Bishop José Wellington Bezerra da Costa directly prayed for his election as president, and allies are seeking meetings with other figures such as Estevam Hernandes and Valdemiro Santiago.

item.title: Ao vivo: André Mendonça é homenageado na Alesp
item.description: Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça will be honored with the Legislative Merit Collar by the São Paulo State Assembly on Monday, April 6, 2026, in the presence of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas. The tribute was proposed by state deputy Oseias de Madureira (PL). Mendonça, appointed to the STF by Jair Bolsonaro, is the rapporteur of the Banco Master and INSS investigations, and his rulings have been used by Bolsonaro supporters to criticize Alexandre de Moraes and President Lula.

item.title: Mudanças partidárias fortaleceram a direita
item.description: Recent party shifts have strengthened Brazil's right wing, with the PL growing and Flávio Bolsonaro emerging as a solid candidate, attracting affiliates seeking alignment with the winning side. However, his controversial statements — including suggestions of election fraud and offering Brazil's rare earths to Trump — pose risks with moderate conservatives. Caiado and the PSD are seen as potential allies or rivals in a possible runoff, contingent on Bolsonaro's campaign stability.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro explica voto favorável ao PL da Misoginia
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, a pre-candidate for the Presidency, justified his favorable vote on the so-called Misogyny Bill by claiming he was not fully following the Senate vote at the time of approval. He stated the bill was processed quickly and he did not have time to analyze it thoroughly.

item.title: Flávio define estratégia para se defender sobre rachadinha: 'Queiroz falou que cobrava e que eu não tinha conhecimento'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro denied involvement in the 'rachadinha' scheme during his time as a state deputy in Rio, stating that former aide Fabrício Queiroz admitted to collecting part of staff salaries, but that he had no knowledge of the practice. He emphasized that over 30 aides had their financial secrecy lifted in investigations, with no evidence of fund transfers between him and employees, and that key evidence was invalidated by rulings from the STJ and STF, leading to the dismissal of the indictment in 2022.

item.title: Moro se irrita ao ser questionado sobre PF no governo Bolsonaro e pede ‘outra pergunta’
item.description: Senator Sergio Moro (PL-PR) showed irritation when questioned about potential interference in the Federal Police under a possible Flávio Bolsonaro government, avoiding the question and shifting criticism to the Lula administration, accusing the PT of corruption and referencing investigations against the president’s son. He reiterated his 2020 resignation from Bolsonaro’s government over alleged PF interference and refused to answer again, saying 'another question'.

item.title: Flávio diz por que foi escolha de Bolsonaro: Não podia tirar Tarcísio de SP
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro said he was chosen by his father, Jair Bolsonaro, as the pre-candidate for president because there was no other viable substitute besides Tarcísio de Freitas to run for governor of São Paulo.

item.title: Tarcísio escolhe duas novas secretárias para o primeiro escalão em São Paulo
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas appointed two new women to his cabinet: Claudia Carletto as Secretary of Sports and Ana Biselli Aidar as Secretary of Tourism and Travel. Both began transition and planning agendas with their technical teams on Tuesday. The appointments reinforce the administration’s commitment to increasing female leadership in state public administration, raising the number of women leading secretariats in the top tier to eight.

item.title: “Não é inteligente”, diz Flávio sobre postura de Eduardo Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro criticized his brother Eduardo Bolsonaro's stance, calling it unintelligent. He revealed he has been working behind the scenes to moderate Eduardo's statements, as the latter, living in the U.S., has caused tensions with fellow bolsonarista allies.

item.title: Zema descarta ser vice de Flávio: “Não recebi convite, nem tenho interesse”
item.description: Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and presidential pre-candidate for Novo, stated he did not receive an invitation to be Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) running mate and has no interest in the role. He affirmed he will maintain his pre-candidacy 'until the end' and respects other right-wing pre-candidates.

item.title: Aldo Rebelo defende Neymar após críticas sobre árbitro
item.description: Aldo Rebelo defended footballer Neymar after criticism for remarks about referee Sávio Pereira Sampaio, stating that personal opinions do not justify persecution or hate campaigns. He compared the situation to other Brazilian football icons like Romário and Ronaldo, whose views he did not always share but still admired for elevating Brazil’s global reputation. Rebelo stressed that Neymar’s on-field performance must be respected regardless of his off-field comments.

item.title: Tarcísio critica PT por querer compartilhar paternidade de obras em SP
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) criticized the PT for attempting to share credit for projects like the 17-Ouro Metro Line and the Northern Rodoanel, stating these works were delayed for decades and only completed under his administration. He accused the opposition of using TV propaganda to claim ownership of state achievements, following Fernando Haddad’s (PT) first electoral insert highlighting federal funds for São Paulo infrastructure.
